definition: a small figure moved on strings
description: By a stone fountain in a sunny town square, a smiling young man with black hair, in a cream knitted jumper and a chain necklace, holds a wooden cross of strings and makes a painted wooden puppet boy in a striped suit dance on the fountain's rim. The puppet kicks up a leg, bows towards a grey pigeon standing next to crumbs, and reaches a hand out to it while the pigeon stares at the puppet. Water sprays from the fountain, and friends and an old man watch and laugh.

en.question: What is the pigeon staring at?
